name: l0_base_perception_defaults
about: The four base-entity perception queries on a plain entity (`walks/L0-r020.md`), a `logic_relay` created at runtime: no NPC (CAI_BaseNPC 0x102789c0 overrides slot 197, CAI_BaseNPCTroika 0x101aa610 / 0x101aa630 slots 28 / 29) and not the player (CBasePlayer 0x10174e60 slot 197, 0x10177bf0 slot 200; CHL2_Player 0x1034f370 / 0x1034f390 slots 28 / 29). `CBaseEntity::BodyTarget` 0x1009f2c0 (slot 197, `RET 0x10`): the scope-trace push, then `CALL [vtable+0x300]` -- slot 192 `WorldSpaceCenter()` -- into the hidden return pointer (`1009f329`-`1009f330`); `posSrc` and both bools are never read, so `BodyTarget(v, true, false)` and `BodyTarget(0, false, false)` both equal `WorldSpaceCenter()` bit for bit (`equal=1`). `CBaseEntity::GetStealthVisionScalar` 0x10026610 (slot 28) and `GetStealthVisionCone` 0x10026630 (slot 29) are each `FLD [0x104454c0]; RET`: the pooled float 1.0. `CBaseEntity::Illumination` 0x100ad6e0 (slot 200): the trace push and pop, then `MOV EAX,0x80; RET`: 128, an int; no retail dispatch site reaches it, so its value is checked, not a use. Reported as `fail`, a value differs from retail's or BodyTarget differs from slot 192's answer.
